blocks.heading: Privacy Polic
blocks.body:
**SkyPost Privacy Policy**
_Last updated: May 26, 2026_

***

**Overview**

SkyPost is designed to share as little data as possible. There is no account registration, no email address required, and no user profile stored on our servers. You are identified only by an anonymous 6-character code that your device generates locally.

***

**What We Collect**

**1. User Code**
Your device generates a random 6-character code on first launch. This code is stored on your device and synced privately via Apple iCloud (CloudKit). It is not tied to your name, email, or Apple ID on our end.

**2. Messages and Sounds**
All messages and audio clips sent between users are end-to-end encrypted using Curve25519 key exchange and AES-GCM encryption via Apple CryptoKit. Encryption keys are stored exclusively in your device's iOS Keychain. We cannot read your messages. No message content is stored on our servers.

**3. Push Notifications**
SkyPost uses a Cloudflare Worker relay to deliver push notifications. Notification payloads are encrypted and contain no readable message content when previews are disabled. Your APNs device token is stored only for the purpose of delivering notifications to your device.

**4. Bluesky Account (Optional)**
If you connect a Bluesky account, SkyPost stores your Bluesky handle and an App Password locally on your device. This credential is used only to communicate directly with the Bluesky API (bsky.app) on your behalf. We do not store your Bluesky credentials on our servers.

**5. Photos and Media**
Photos and memes you attach to messages or Bluesky posts are accessed only at the moment you choose to share them. They are sent directly to the recipient or posted to Bluesky. We do not retain copies.

**6. Video Calls**
Video calls use LiveKit's real-time infrastructure. Call audio and video are not recorded or stored. LiveKit's privacy policy applies to in-call data: [https://livekit.io/privacy](vscode-file://vscode-app/Applications/Visual%20Studio%20Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html)

**7. In-App Purchases**
Purchases are handled entirely by Apple via StoreKit. SkyPost does not receive or store your payment information. Apple's privacy policy governs purchase data: [https://www.apple.com/legal/privacy](vscode-file://vscode-app/Applications/Visual%20Studio%20Code.app/Contents/Resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html)

***

**What We Do Not Collect**

- Name, email address, or phone number
- Location data
- Advertising identifiers or tracking cookies
- Behavioral analytics or usage telemetry
- Third-party social login credentials

***

**Third-Party Services**

| Service | Purpose | Privacy Policy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Apple CloudKit | Message transport, buddy sync, key exchange | apple.com/legal/privacy |
| Apple StoreKit | In-app purchases | apple.com/legal/privacy |
| LiveKit | Real-time video calls | livekit.io/privacy |
| Cloudflare | Push notification relay | cloudflare.com/privacypolicy |
| Bluesky (AT Protocol) | Optional social posting | bsky.social/about/support/privacy-policy |

***

**Data Retention**

Messages are stored locally on your device via SwiftData. CloudKit syncs data across your own devices only. You can delete all conversations and data by deleting the app or clearing app data in iOS Settings.

***

**Children**

SkyPost is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect any data from children.

***

**Changes to This Policy**

We will update this page and change the "Last updated" date when this policy changes. Continued use of SkyPost after changes constitutes acceptance.

***
